definition: `DesirableIn x p`: x, as having the perfection p, is desirable, an object toward which appetite tends. In Lean `DesirableIn` is a parameter: its content is fixed only by STMT-GOOD-IS-DESIRABLE and STMT-DESIRABLE-INSOFAR-AS-PERFECT. Whose appetite is not specified.
note: ST I q.5 a.1 co. uses appetibile without defining it apart from the good; the per-perfection, parameter reading is a modeling choice. A sourced definition would come from Aquinas on the object of appetite (ST I q.80 a.1, already pinned; see DEF-APPETITIVE-OBJECT-ASPECT), which relates the appetible to the good and so would not give an independent definition.
